reviewNotes: Curated for a casual leveling guild, not speedrunning or raid rankings.
Publisher update dates are distinct from our review date. Prelaunch/beta advice is labelled.
No fixed talent allocation, quest waypoint or bulk shopping list is copied or automatically applied.
Method early crafting routes are capped at skill 224 where the author describes coverage through 225.
Automatic source health checks do not count as a content review.
Official tuning announced for November 10 requires renewed content checks after it lands.

2026-11-09: Rechecked source text and official tuning. Corrected focused class-path labels, partial Skinning/Herbalism coverage and Leatherworking beta status. November 10 tuning remains announced, not confirmed live. Nine automated Mobalytics requests returned 403; relevant pages were read through the web tool instead. Icy Veins text remained unchanged despite raw hash changes.
